canonical_project: 1-5 Khartoum Road Data Centre / EdgeConneX SYD1 MPark
notes: NSW Planning Portal approved SSD-63235720 on 2026-03-11 for the City of Ryde data-storage project; public submissions describe a 76.4 MW facility. Baxtel identifies the Macquarie Park 1-5 Khartoum Road project as EdgeConneX SYD1 MPark developed through a Stockland joint venture.
